title: Hypothesis spec
description: Principles.md 2.7. The required list is verbatim from 2.7 and is the source of truth for optlab.specs.load (11.5: code implements the spec). Missing OR empty required fields fail; an empty string, empty list or null is not a registered field. Extra keys are permitted -- the point of this file is completeness, not prohibition.

id.description: Registry key. Retries take a suffix (H-2026-007-r1, 7.x); the original is never edited in place.

registered_utc.description: ISO-8601. Pre-registration is meaningless without a timestamp that predates the run.

mechanism.description: 2.9a disqualifier: must name who is forced or compensated. No mechanism, no spec.

computable_pit.description: 2.9a: a trigger needing revised data or a value from the future is disqualified. Stated explicitly so the claim is on the record and falsifiable.

estimation_universe.description: Wide: estimate the effect where the sample is.

trading_universe.description: Narrow: trade it where the liquidity is.

subgroup_check.description: Mandatory (2.7). An effect that vanishes in the names you intend to trade is not tradeable.

outcome_variable.description: 2.9a: a scalar computable per event, or the idea is dead.

falsification.description: A number that would make you abandon it. Written before the result exists, or it will be written after it.

sample_size_expected.description: 2.7: must carry the MEASURED cluster count from the 2.9b pre-flight, not an estimate. A spec whose sample was never counted cannot be registered -- hence measured_utc is required.

independent_clusters.description: The real sample: events separated by more than ~1.4x the holding window. This powers every statistic (2.9b).

per_year.description: >150/yr is a regime, not a signal.

measured_utc.description: When the count was actually run. An absent date means nobody counted.

trials.description: The pre-enumerated trial configurations. PROGRAM.md (registered 2026-08-19) fixes the budget at 8 and requires the configurations be enumerated in the spec BEFORE the first run, so the multiple-testing denominator is fixed in advance rather than discovered afterwards (4.2). maxItems is that budget, mechanically.

params.description: The question asked of the data. Keys here must match what optlab.stats.trials.guard() is handed.
